name: core.openwop.connections.salesforce
description: Salesforce connection pack — OAuth2 (web-server flow) provider for the Salesforce REST API. DEPLOY-GATED. Reach is `openapi`: Salesforce has no single global first-party MCP server (the API lives on a per-org `*.my.salesforce.com` instance host, supplied per connection via instanceUrlTemplate), so a documented OpenAPI/REST surface is the honest day-1 reach. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the connected-app consumer key/secret host-side.
